description: Approved official and relevant institutional sources for monitoring agricultural finance, grants and machinery resources. Sources are checked automatically where possible and changes enter a human review queue before publication.

sources.publisher: International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD)
sources.notes: Official IFAD grants programme information.

sources.publisher: International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD)
sources.notes: Official IFAD call-for-proposals page; opportunities and closing dates can change.

sources.publisher: International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD)
sources.notes: Official IFAD agricultural and rural finance information.

sources.publisher: International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD)
sources.notes: Official IFAD rural finance information and programme context.

sources.publisher: African Development Bank Group
sources.notes: Official Agri-Food SME Catalytic Financing Mechanism information.

sources.publisher: African Development Bank Group
sources.notes: Official Africa Fertilizer Financing Mechanism information.

sources.publisher: African Development Bank Group
sources.notes: Official GAFSP financial instruments information.

sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
sources.notes: Official FAO Africa mechanization resource; used as a machinery/mechanization information source.

sources.publisher: African Development Bank Group
sources.notes: Official NAMSIP project and mechanisation information.

sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
sources.notes: Official FAO machinery supply-chain, hire and repair resource.

sources.publisher: National Agricultural Development Fund (Nigeria)
sources.notes: Official NADF FAQ describing agricultural finance, on-lending and eligibility routes; verify current products and participating institutions before listing.

sources.publisher: Central Bank of Nigeria
sources.notes: Official Agricultural Credit Guarantee Scheme Fund information; confirm current application process with the relevant lending bank before listing.

sources.publisher: Ghana Ministry of Food and Agriculture
sources.notes: Official Ghana Agriculture Sector Investment Programme page covering value-chain financing and grant mechanisms; verify current programme status and eligibility before listing.

sources.publisher: Government Advertising Agency, Kenya
sources.notes: Official government news on agricultural financing allocations; contextual monitoring source, not proof that a specific grant or loan is open.

sources.publisher: National e-Agriculture Web Portal / Federal Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official portal listing agricultural machinery classes and sources; verify supplier contacts and availability before publishing.

sources.publisher: National e-Agriculture Web Portal / Federal Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official portal describing agricultural credit facilities and lending institutions; confirm present availability with providers.

sources.publisher: Central Bank of Nigeria
sources.notes: Official CACS scheme information including machinery financing; scheme page is historical, so verify current application availability before listing as open.

sources.publisher: Fundo de Apoio ao Desenvolvimento Agrário (FADA)
sources.notes: Official investment-financing page includes agricultural equipment and tractor categories; confirm current terms, availability and eligibility before publication.

sources.publisher: Rwanda Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources (MINAGRI)
sources.notes: Official 2026 report describing concessional agricultural lending through participating financial institutions. Verify current rates, participating lenders and eligibility before listing as an available offer.

sources.publisher: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board (RAB)
sources.notes: Official Farm Power Technology Programme page on mechanization services, equipment and links to service providers; confirm current programme activities before publication.

sources.publisher: Fundo de Apoio ao Desenvolvimento Agrário (FADA)
sources.notes: Official FADA financing application procedure; applicants must check current product terms and submit required documents through official channels.

sources.publisher: FDRE Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official National Agricultural Mechanization Strategy 2026–2035. Policy and planning resource, not a direct equipment offer; review for current implementation opportunities before listing.

sources.publisher: FDRE Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official 2026 report on farm machinery distributed through an agricultural value-chain project. Context for identifying current project contacts; not proof of an open equipment application.

sources.publisher: Development Bank of Ethiopia
sources.notes: Official project-financing information includes commercial agriculture and agro-processing. Applicants must confirm current eligibility, terms and availability directly with the bank.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF), Uganda
sources.notes: Official agricultural mechanization services and tractor access/management guidance. Confirm current district-level equipment access and service terms before listing.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF), Uganda
sources.notes: Official micro-scale irrigation matching-grant programme information. Confirm current application window, approved equipment, farmer contribution and eligibility before presenting as open.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF), Uganda
sources.notes: Official Agricultural Investment Unit page describing links to agricultural credit facilities and support for agribusiness proposals. It is a guidance/contact route, not confirmation of an open grant.

sources.publisher: Zambia Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official report on 40 mechanization service centres and equipment handed to districts under a development project. Confirm current centre locations, service availability and fees locally.

sources.publisher: Zambia Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official ministry portal currently links Sustainable Agriculture Financing Facility information and application materials. Verify the specific form, application period and eligibility on the linked official document before listing.

sources.publisher: Zambia Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official Sustainable Agriculture Financing Facility (SAFF) programme page describing eligibility and application route. Confirm current season, participating banks, remaining funds and application status before listing as currently open.

sources.publisher: Malawi Ministry of Agriculture / AgriInvestment platform
sources.notes: Official agricultural investment opportunities portal covering finance and insurance, mechanization, irrigation, inputs and other agribusiness areas. Treat as an investment/opportunity directory, not evidence that a specific grant or loan is open.

sources.publisher: Presidential Initiatives in Agriculture and Agribusiness (Ghana)
sources.notes: Official government overview of agricultural transformation initiatives and investment/infrastructure priorities. Use for programme discovery; do not imply a live grant or loan application unless a specific open call is verified.

sources.publisher: Tanzania Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official Ministry directory describing the Agricultural Mechanisation and Irrigation Division, machinery information/advisory functions and coordination responsibilities. It is a government contact and service-discovery source, not a machinery sales listing or proof of an open subsidy.

sources.publisher: Senegal Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock
sources.notes: Official notice on the Senegal Agricultural Mechanization Programme (PMAS 2026–2030) and subsidized groundnut cleaning equipment described for the 2025–2026 campaign. Verify campaign dates, remaining allocations and current eligibility before presenting support as open.

sources.publisher: Agricultural Commercialisation Project (AGCOM), Malawi Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official agricultural commercialisation project portal reporting matching-grant windows, productive alliances, farmer/cooperative support and project news. Check the specific call, eligibility, contribution requirements and closing date before describing any grant as open.

sources.publisher: Centre for Agricultural Mechanization and Rural Technology (CAMARTEC), Tanzania
sources.notes: Official CAMARTEC programme page describing supply of modern agricultural mechanization equipment. Verify actual equipment inventory, prices, delivery coverage and procurement process directly with CAMARTEC.

sources.publisher: Zambia Ministry of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official Ministry portal currently advertises 2026/2027 FISP e-voucher input-supplier registration. This is a supplier registration notice, not necessarily an open farmer grant; monitor for the exact notice/download and distinguish farmer eligibility from supplier applications.

sources.publisher: Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA), Morocco
sources.notes: Official government agricultural development fund incentives, including agricultural machinery and irrigation investment support. Verify current rates, applicant eligibility, application windows and local implementing office before presenting as available.

sources.publisher: South African Department of Agriculture
sources.notes: Official producer support and development guidance directing applicants to provincial or regional agriculture departments. Not itself a live open grant call; confirm provincial programme and current application status.

sources.publisher: Egypt Digital Climate and Environmental Investment Portal / Agricultural Bank of Egypt
sources.notes: Government-hosted Arabic listing describes agricultural mechanization finance for small farmers, cooperatives and agricultural projects. Confirm product terms, current limits, interest, and bank availability directly before publication.

sources.publisher: CBZ Holdings
sources.notes: Lender's own page describes a microfinance agriculture loan for smallholder farmers. This is a commercial loan, not a government grant; confirm current loan limits, security requirements, rates and availability.

sources.publisher: Algerian Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development
sources.notes: Official ministry information about RFIG seasonal subsidised credit and ETTAHADI investment credit. Confirm current terms, participating bank procedures and eligibility before presenting as currently available.

sources.publisher: Government of Benin, Government Action Programme portal
sources.notes: Official Government of Benin programme portal lists the National Agricultural Mechanisation Development Programme and related agriculture projects. Confirm current implementation and application channels; a programme listing is not an open call.

sources.publisher: Banque Agricole du Faso (BADF)
sources.notes: Agricultural bank information on production credit, farm working capital, equipment and agricultural development financing. Verify current product terms, borrower criteria and availability with the bank.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Water, Animal and Fisheries Resources of Burkina Faso
sources.notes: Official ministry projects and programmes index includes agricultural mechanisation modernisation and other rural development projects. Use as programme context; verify active status and current beneficiary calls.

sources.publisher: Government of Botswana, Ministry of Lands and Agriculture
sources.notes: Official service assesses farm business plans for submission to financial institutions. It is advisory support, not a grant or loan by itself; eligibility and service requirements are stated on the official page.

sources.publisher: Thuo Letlotlo, Botswana Ministry of Agriculture programme
sources.notes: Official programme describes livestock support packages and grants. Confirm whether applications are open, current package rules, citizen-only eligibility and approved supplier requirements before presenting as an active opportunity.

sources.publisher: Government of Benin, Government Action Programme portal
sources.notes: Official programme page describes agricultural credit access, subsidised credit-linked support, equipment acquisition financing and agricultural insurance measures. Confirm current eligibility, financing terms and active application windows; do not assume every listed measure is currently open.

sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Benin
sources.notes: Government report dated 9 August 2026 on agricultural insurance indemnities for the 2025-2026 season and intended expansion for 2026-2027. This is programme status/context, not a direct open application; verify current enrolment through the ministry/FNDA.

sources.publisher: Cameroon Ministry of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises, Social Economy and Handicrafts
sources.notes: Official ministry page describes the PMEAA programme supporting agricultural and agro-food SMEs, including credit access and non-financial business support. The description references an earlier programme cycle; verify whether current support or successor programmes remain available before listing it as an opportunity.

sources.publisher: ECOWAS Regional Agency for Agriculture and Food (ARAA)
sources.notes: ECOWAS update dated 30 July 2026 describes PRIMA regional agricultural market integration activities in Togo and Benin. Use as regional programme context; verify any farmer/SME application route separately.

sources.publisher: Burundi Ministry of Environment, Agriculture and Livestock (MINEAGRIE)
sources.notes: Official ministry news page includes reporting on a pilot distribution of power tillers to selected cooperatives. Treat this as historical programme context only; verify whether any current equipment support, training or application channel is open before listing it as an opportunity.

sources.publisher: Government of Côte d’Ivoire, official government news portal
sources.notes: Official report dated 19 July 2026 describes equipment and input distribution through 2PAI-NORD and PADSV to producer organisations in four northern regions. This is evidence of project support, not an open nationwide application; verify current beneficiary selection and project channels.

sources.publisher: United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS), World Bank-funded agricultural support
sources.notes: Institutional project update reports World Bank-financed support to Chad's agricultural sector, including fertilizer deliveries in 2026. Use as project context, not a direct farmer grant application; verify implementing agency, beneficiary eligibility and any current calls.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Water, Fisheries, Livestock and Fisheries Resources, Djibouti
sources.notes: Official ministry portal lists rural development, agro-food resilience and water-resilience projects, including the FAR project. Verify current calls and whether farmers or cooperatives can apply; project descriptions alone do not confirm open funding.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, Democratic Republic of the Congo (MINASA)
sources.notes: Official ministry project directory lists AVENIR, PADRIR and the National Agricultural Development Programme (PNDA). The listed PNDA period is 2022–2025, so verify current successor status and farmer-access channels before presenting any project as active support.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, Democratic Republic of the Congo (MINASA)
sources.notes: Official ministry report dated 17 March 2026 describes tractor and input handovers and support for young agripreneurs in Tshopo. This is a specific project report, not proof of an open national application; confirm local selection and current beneficiary routes.
